hypothesis: Training the E034-accepted long-budget recipe (identical controls, only num_updates 600 -> 3000) on all 81 usable public real trajectories will produce the strongest available frozen backbone for adapter retraining and packaging. There is no leakage-safe local holdout for this checkpoint (it trains on every public real trajectory), so acceptance is by training integrity, evaluator-compatible loading, and its role as the E036 adapter substrate rather than by a holdout quality gate.
comparator: E011 all-public 600-update backbone (the current all-data packaging substrate used by E021/E029/E033 members); no clean local holdout comparison is possible or claimed
